analysis.title: Everyone Is Positioned For Pain. What If Nothing Breaks
key_insights: GS flags an unusual setup into Q3 earnings: a tense macro backdrop and very light positioning, but little panic in vol.
The GS Monetary Policy Factor is at -8, near the bottom of its 30-year range. Hedge fund US net positioning is in the 0th percentile.
Non-dealers sold $63.7bn of S&P futures over six weeks, selling in five of the six weeks. The latest week added $10.5bn, with asset managers responsible for $11.7bn.
More than 70% of the six-week S&P futures move came from long liquidation rather than new shorts.
Asset-manager gross longs have a strongly negative relationship with 10-year real yields. A 25bp jump in real yields coincided with another $5.5bn of asset-manager long liquidation.
If real yields roll over, one of the main reasons for cutting equity exposure reverses, making rates the key upside trigger.
Tech had its largest percentage net selling in six weeks, concentrated in EM Asia and Europe with semis leading. Software saw net buying.
Gross and net Tech allocations remain in the 96th percentile versus the past five years despite the selling.
Russell 2000 systematic exposure is in the 7th percentile and leveraged funds hold record shorts per CFTC data through September 22.
About $900mn of Russell open interest has come out since September 29 after softer PCE and payrolls, and RTY funding spreads have richened outright and versus SPX.
MOVE shows early signs of stabilizing or reversing. If bond vol cools, yields ease and earnings hold up, the pain trade looks higher.

sector_views.rationale: Being de-risked at the margin, led by semis, but allocations remain in the 96th percentile versus five years.
Saw net buying while the rest of tech was sold.
Positioning is washed out and leveraged funds hold record shorts, which sets up squeeze fuel if rates help.

earnings_insights: Q3 earnings season is framed as a possible clearing event for a defensive market if the macro backdrop stops getting worse. No specific EPS or revenue figures are cited.

tension_points.what_invalidates: Real yields and MOVE continuing to rise instead of rolling over into earnings season.
